seed: Copy on the range's own right click. At Next defaults: a range drawn from 0:02 to 0:04 on the sample recording, Copy chosen from its right-click menu, then Paste from the ruler's right-click at the playhead lays it in at 0:08.

steps.note: a walk's right click cannot put the pointer over the ruler, so the menu acts at the playhead, the ruler's own fallback: the playhead inside the range is the click on the band. Cut and Copy sit with Delete and Ripple Delete
Paste from the ruler's right click lays the two copied seconds in at 0:08
